The device-tree backend owns structural access, property decoding, node status and device-tree address translation.

Kernel registration, IRQ mapping, MMIO mapping and DMA allocation remain outside the device-tree library's responsibility.

Keep boot DTB ownership in host integration until migrated; helpers outside the scoped migration remain separately tracked debt.

The frozen design document reports device-to-controller IRQ lookup through FwIrqSpec as not included and Unsupported in DtBackend.

The design lists from_madt and from_static as planned producers; this statement alone does not establish implemented entry points.

docs_source-revised.text:
Empty input returns zero; requests exceeding 4096 bytes are rejected before copying or invoking the write handler.

For nonempty input of at most 4096 bytes, invoke self.write once only after the whole payload has been collected successfully; a collection error or zero progress invokes no handler.

The concrete CommandFile::write method returns the entire supplied byte count if its handler succeeds; its handler does not return a short byte count.

Advance file position only after write completion and successful rewind checks; a rewind error can return early and does not undo arbitrary handler side effects.
